Subject: Initial phone screen — quick availability (30m)

Hi Natasha,

Thanks for applying to the Product Marketing role and for taking the time to chat. I'd love to set up a 25–30 minute initial phone screen with our hiring team (just to learn more about your background and share next steps).

I have the following windows available next week (PST):
- Tue 2027-12-14: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2027-12-15: 09:00–11:00 or 14:30–16:30

If any of those work, tell me which slot you prefer and your timezone. I can send an invite (ICS) and include a short agenda. If none of these fit, share 3 times that do and I'll coordinate.

I took a look at your resume — could you also attach the latest copy if it's handy?

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks — excited about the opportunity. I'm in IST (UTC+5:30). Of the times you listed, Wed 2027-12-15 at 14:30–15:00 PST would work well for me (that should be Thu 2027-12-16 01:00–01:30 IST). If possible, could we move it 30 minutes earlier on that day (14:00 PST -> 00:30 IST)? I finish my current commitments at midnight IST but could do 00:30 if it's more convenient.
